title: GTS SuperTech 300 HPE (Adventure Spec)
description: The Vespa GTS SuperTech 300 HPE (Adventure Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Commuter Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 300cc engine generating 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
